# folio-assistant-tests

Tests about the WHOLE CHECKOUT: each reads several sibling instances at once, or the aggregate root itself (`.github/`, `.gitignore`, `AGENTS.md`, this declaration, the root state graphs `beans/`, `todos/`, `memory/`, `fsh-guts/`). Owner ruling 2026-10-06, "Top-level instance" (bean `7zz1`, epic `iirv`): whatever names every layer belongs at the top, so each layer below stays green when it stands alone, and `check:cat-harness-standalone` collects none of these. `test/` rather than `tests/` because `directory-conventions` settled the spelling on 2026-09-19 (`test/` is the one test tree, and the rule for the next one). Each moved file composes its paths from `ORIGIN_DIR`, the directory it was written in, so nothing it reads changed in the move. `code`, like every other `*-tests` entry: authored test sources, discovered by a root `bun test` and compiled by `tsc` through the root tsconfig's `test/**` glob.

Part of [Folio Assistant](../README.md) 0.1.0, declared as `folio-assistant-tests`, holding `code`.
